description: This file defines the EntityTypeRepository class in Drupal, providing methods for loading and managing entity types, including retrieving labels and mapping classes to entity types.

classes.name: EntityTypeRepository
classes.description: A class providing helper methods for loading entity types in Drupal, including label retrieval and class-to-entity type mapping.

methods.name: getEntityTypeLabels
methods.description: Returns labels for entity types, optionally grouped and sorted, with 'Content' group prioritized.

methods.name: getEntityTypeFromClass
methods.description: Maps a class name to an entity type ID, checking cached mappings, definitions, and bundle info, throwing exceptions on ambiguity or absence.
